component.name: Subixa Player
component.summary: Watch films with a docked, searchable subtitle browser

description.p: Subixa is a desktop video player with a docked, searchable subtitle list. Every line of every subtitle track is shown timestamped beside the video: click a line to jump to it, search the whole track, and the line currently playing highlights and scrolls itself into view.

It is built for people who read subtitles — language learners, subtitle editors, anyone doing a QC pass — rather than for people who happen to have them switched on. Tracks can be browsed per tab, exported, shifted against the picture, and styled independently of the player's own theme.
Playback is libmpv underneath: the usual formats, hardware decoding, folder queues, per-file resume and remembered subtitle tracks.
